notes: Third-party runtimes the Neubit VMS native appliance supervises (docs/WINDOWS_NATIVE_APPLIANCE.md). Not committed: fetch-binaries.ps1 installs them under <data root>\bin, verifying each sha256 BEFORE extracting and writing vendorbin.lock.json. checksumSource says whether a digest is the publisher's own (checksumUrl) or was computed from a download made while pinning ('local': it pins against later substitution but is not an upstream attestation). The postgresql, vcredist, node and ffmpeg entries are the SAME pins the Neubit NVR ships (neubit_nvr deploy/windows/binaries.json), so one server running both products holds one verified copy of each artifact's bytes.

artifacts.name: postgresql
artifacts.notes: PostgreSQL 17 for the builtin C.UTF-8 locale provider (identical collation on Windows and Linux). bin, lib and share stay siblings: postgres.exe finds share/ and lib/ relative to itself, and TimescaleDB below is placed INTO lib and share/extension. Same pin and digest as the NVR.

artifacts.name: timescaledb
artifacts.licence: Apache-2.0 (core) + Timescale License (TSL: compression, continuous aggregates)
artifacts.notes: 2.17.2 to match the Docker stack's timescale/timescaledb:2.17.2-pg16, so the reporting store's hypertables, compression and continuous aggregates behave identically, built here for PG 17. The release publishes no checksum file; digest computed from a download of 6282490 bytes on 2026-10-08. The bundled setup.exe and timescaledb-tune.exe are deliberately NOT extracted: placement is done by these rules, tuning by the appliance's own overlay (pgboot).

artifacts.name: vcredist
artifacts.notes: The EnterpriseDB binaries import VCRUNTIME140.dll / MSVCP140.dll, absent on a clean Windows; without it postgres exits 0xc0000135. install-appliance.ps1 verifies the Authenticode signature, then runs it /install /quiet /norestart. Same pin as the NVR.

artifacts.name: node
artifacts.notes: Runs the two Next.js standalone builds (console and admin). Next 16 needs Node >= 20.9; 22 LTS. Same pin as the NVR.

artifacts.name: nats
artifacts.notes: The event bus with JetStream. 2.10.x to match the Docker stack's nats:2.10-alpine; v2.10.29 is that line's newest.

artifacts.name: traefik
artifacts.notes: The gateway: the repo's own gateway/dynamic routes and middlewares (ForwardAuth, rate limit, media auth), rendered for loopback upstreams. 3.1.x to match the Docker stack's traefik:v3.1.

artifacts.name: ffmpeg
artifacts.notes: vision's snapshot grabs (one frame from an RTSP stream, no encoding to H.264). LGPL shared build deliberately, the NVR's licensing decision. Same pin as the NVR.

artifacts.name: poppler
artifacts.licence: GPL-2.0-or-later (invoked as a separate program, never linked)
artifacts.notes: pdftoppm for core's floor-plan PDF import (pdf2image shells out to it; the Docker image installs poppler-utils). Run as a separate executable, as on Linux. The release publishes no checksum; digest computed from a download of 43709956 bytes on 2026-10-08.
